How to draw cobweb 🕸️ on your coloring pages. I take two dark markers and cover the background. Then I take a white gel pen and draw the lines of the cobweb over the background. Try not to go back over the lines too much because thinner lines appears more authentic to cobweb. I add water dots to give it that morning dew look.
